preconditions.description: The number of integers q is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= a_i <= 2**25 - 1 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each integer a_i in the list a is between 2 and 2^25 - 1 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of input integers q.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= result_i <= a_i for result_i, a_i in zip(stdout, a))
postconditions.description: Each result_i in the output is between 1 and the corresponding a_i inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(result_i == max(gcd(a_i ^ b, a_i & b) for b in range(1, a_i)) for result_i, a_i in zip(stdout, a))
postconditions.description: Each result_i in the output is the maximum GCD of a_i XOR b and a_i AND b for all b in the range 1 to a_i - 1.
